text:
jordan: Kicking off a quick mini canary now — 5% traffic to v2 via traffic-gate. I'll post short checks every 10m.

What I did: pushed v2 (2026.3.2), added a health-thread probe tweak, and set canary slice to `mini-canary`.
Blockers: saw one serve error in staging earlier but cleared after a config tweak.
Today: monitor (latency / errors) and decide on ramp to 20% in ~30m if stable.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: service=infer-gateway env=prod version=2026.3.2 slice=mini-canary status=ok :white_check_mark:

maya: watching metrics now — p50/p95/p99 + error-rate. will ping if p95 > 120ms or errors spike :eyes:

sam: FYI saw a small uptick in 500s around 10:38 on eu-west-1 slice. only ~0.3% but noticeable relative to baseline. can't repro locally. @hemant can you take a look at LB?

hemant: looking — LB config shows sticky-session TTL mismatch for that slice. pushing a fix (will update in 2m)

jordan: thanks. if LB fix doesn't drop errors in 5m -> we rollback v2 on eu-west for the mini-canary. keep the feature flag open for now.

ops-oncall: noted oncall handoff at 11:00 PT, i'll be available for rollback ops if needed :thumbsup:

leila: quick flag note: this canary is gated by account_tier=trial so production traffic surface is limited. confirming churn impact is low.

maya: metric snapshot at 10:42 — p95=98ms, error-rate=0.15% (baseline 0.05%). upward blip aligns with 10:38 eu-west window.

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer RE---REDACTED' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-vicuna-v2","input":"hello"}'
```

sam: if we plan to ramp, let's enable prefix-cache for v2; should help tail latencies.

maya: agree — I can flip the rollout config: traffic-gate.cache=true for v2 when we ramp.

jordan: patch the gate when ready. i'll wait 8m and then decide. if stable -> ramp to 20% at +30m from now.

hemant: LB patch applied, 500s trending down to baseline. monitoring for 3m.

leila: scheduling: ramp to 20% set for 11:00 PT, will keep gate open for +15m post-ramp.

maya: snapshot after LB fix: p95=92ms, error-rate=0.06% — looks good. recommending green to ramp. :rocket:

jordan: ok green from me. will trigger ramp at 11:00 PT and enable cache toggle during ramp. thanks everyone. i'll create a brief postmortem checklist/notes PR later.

leila: noted — i'll update rollout doc and toggle audience flags.

ops-oncall: keeping eyes on the dashboards; ping if anything regresses.

sam: thanks — will watch long-tail logs and surface any anomalies.

jordan: closing update: mini canary went green, ramp scheduled, and follow-ups assigned. will post final status after +15m verify.
